plan: Rank the catalog once by (numeric priority, original catalog index) so choice selection is deterministic; look up substitutions by the choice's `for` name.
Scale every quantity by Fraction(target_yield)/Fraction(recipe yield) up front; substitution `quantity_factor`s multiply on top, keeping all arithmetic in fractions.Fraction.

Resolve each excluded ingredient with an iterative substitution chain carrying an immutable seen-set: repeat while the current name is excluded, emitting `no substitution for NAME` when the catalog has no entry and `substitution cycle involving NAME` when a name repeats.
Recurse into `additional_ingredients` with the inherited seen-set so extras face the same exclusions/catalog and reintroduced exclusions chain or report cycles.

Accumulate effects in a session object (ordered choice IDs, wording pairs, equipment additions/removals, warnings, a reason set) so every independently applicable reason is collected instead of stopping at the first.

Apply wording changes as ordered old->new string replacements over fresh copies of instruction lists; compute equipment as (original + additions - removals), sorted, and emit `equipment NAME unavailable` per missing item.
Process components with an isolated sub-session: optional components that fail are dropped with a warning; required ones merge their reasons into the main session.
Never mutate inputs: build all output dicts/lists fresh; `print_original` simply returns `authored_text`, so the original prints byte-for-byte after any number of adaptations.
Return {possible, recipe|None, ordered choices, sorted deduped warnings, sorted reasons}; include a __main__ acceptance suite covering every contract case.
mechanisms: stable (priority, catalog-index) ranking for deterministic substitution choice
iterative substitution chain with immutable seen-set for cycle detection
recursive resolution of additional ingredients under the same exclusions
session accumulator collecting all independent impossibility reasons
pure-Fraction yield scaling with multiplicative replacement factors
ordered old->new wording replacement over copied instruction lists
set-algebra equipment reconciliation checked against availability
copy-on-build non-mutation discipline preserving authored_text exactly
isolated sub-session for optional-component drop semantics
